segments.speaker: receptionist
segments.text: Hello, Riverside dental practice, Emma speaking.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Hi, I would like to book a check up please. I have not been in for about a year.

segments.speaker: receptionist
segments.text: Of course. Could I take your date of birth and the first line of your address?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Yes, it is the fourth of March, nineteen eighty six, and I live at twelve Mill Lane.

segments.speaker: receptionist
segments.text: Thank you. I have found your record. We have an appointment on Tuesday at half past two, or Friday at ten in the morning.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Friday at ten would be better for me.

segments.speaker: receptionist
segments.text: Lovely. That is booked for you.

segments.speaker: receptionist
segments.text: We will send a reminder text the day before. Is there anything else I can help with?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: No, that is everything. Thanks, bye.
